an4.201:3.3: And they steal, and encourage others to steal;
an4.201:3.4: And they engage in sexual misconduct, and encourage others to do the same;
an4.201:3.5: And they lie, and encourage others to lie;
an4.201:3.6: And they consume intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor, and encourage others to do the same.
an4.201:5.3: And they refrain from stealing, and encourage others to refrain from stealing;
an4.201:5.4: And they refrain from sexual misconduct, and encourage others to refrain from it;
an4.201:5.5: And they refrain from lying, and encourage others to refrain from it;
an4.201:5.6: And they refrain from consuming intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor, and encourage others to refrain from it.
